title: Topic Hierarchy
description: Denormalized topic taxonomy levels for a topic, from the top-level (L1) root parent down to the deepest (L5) level. Intended for a topic lookup dataset so conversation data can resolve a topic's full hierarchy path. Populate only as many levels as the topic has; unused levels are omitted.

xdm:L1.title: Topic Level 1 (Root)
xdm:L1.description: The highest-level (root) parent topic in the hierarchy.

xdm:L2.title: Topic Level 2
xdm:L2.description: The second-level topic, a child of L1.

xdm:L3.title: Topic Level 3
xdm:L3.description: The third-level topic, a child of L2.

xdm:L4.title: Topic Level 4
xdm:L4.description: The fourth-level topic, a child of L3.

xdm:L5.title: Topic Level 5 (Deepest)
xdm:L5.description: The deepest-level topic, a child of L4.
